topics.title: Anthropic files to go public — IPO roadshow could start next week
topics.why: If Claude's parent company lists at a reported $2T valuation, it's a referendum on whether the AI tools knowledge workers use every day are actually worth what's being poured into them.

topics.title: Microsoft launches "Copilot Cowork," an AI built to do work, not just chat
topics.why: It's the clearest sign yet that workplace AI is shifting from answering questions to handling entire tasks end-to-end — and it reportedly has Claude reviewing GPT's drafts inside the same tool.
